result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that is largely well-structured. A few minor visual issues relate to text truncation and horizontally cut-off content.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge, with both its image and name truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousel items snap cleanly or add visual affordance (like partial card peek with consistent spacing) so truncation looks intentional rather than broken.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card at the bottom is partially cut off by the viewport/bottom navigation, showing only a portion of the item.
issues.suggestion: Verify scroll container padding so cards are not awkwardly clipped behind the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The two favorite (heart) icons use inconsistent styling; one appears with a white/light background and the other with a dark background, which may look inconsistent depending on the underlying image.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background treatment (e.g., consistent semi-transparent scrim) across all cards for visual consistency.
